instruments.name: Reglamento de la Ley de Asentamientos Humanos, Desarrollo Urbano y Ordenamiento Territorial del Estado de Hidalgo
instruments.notes: Provides general development parameters and classifications. It must not be used by itself to declare the official zoning classification of an individual parcel.

instruments.name: Reglamento de Construcciones y Urbanas 2024
instruments.notes: Municipal construction and urban-actions regulatory framework. Article 443 was reformed in 2025; the registry should track later amendments before relying on sanctions or other changed provisions.

instruments.name: Programa de Ordenamiento Ecológico Local del Municipio de Pachuca de Soto
instruments.notes: RUTS identifies this instrument as relevant to the Dictamen de Congruencia for new construction. Exact document URL and parcel-level applicability still require verification.

instruments.name: Programa Municipal de Desarrollo Urbano de Pachuca de Soto 2021/2022
instruments.notes: IMIP currently labels the PMDU 2022 as VIGENTE / HISTÓRICO while also presenting a current PMDU version. EVIDEN must not use this record as an unqualified current zoning authority until the legal status and effective instrument are resolved.

instruments.name: Programa Parcial de Desarrollo Urbano de Pachuca de Soto y Mineral de la Reforma
instruments.notes: Published in Periódico Oficial del Estado de Hidalgo, Alcance 0 No. 34, 514 pages. Before activation, EVIDEN must verify at minimum: (1) publication and approval act, (2) effective date, (3) registration in the Registro Público de la Propiedad y del Comercio, (4) territorial scope/polygons, (5) hierarchy and interaction with PMDU/POEL/regulations, and (6) transitional treatment of previously issued or pending authorizations.
